# ZView replay regression inputs

Copied without modification from ZView's `tests/fixtures/zephyr.elf` and
`tests/fixtures/recordings/sys_heap_v4.3.ndjson.gz` during the desktop extraction.
They are a matching firmware/recording pair used by the exporter regression
test. Retained here so the UI tests do not depend on a sibling ZView checkout.

Upstream: https://github.com/wkhadgar/zview (Apache-2.0).
